mutations.name: every node is placed in band 0
kills: laneLayout places each node inside the box of its own lane

mutations.name: a node's column is its row in the band, not its depth
kills: laneLayout puts a node in the same column layeredLayout gives it

mutations.name: nodes in no lane get no Other band
kills: laneLayout puts a node whose group is not a lane in a trailing Other band

mutations.name: lanes sort by label instead of the given order
kills: laneLayout keeps lanes in the order the caller passes
